findings.what_happened: The model hallucinated external and factually inaccurate cast information for '400 Boys' (claiming it featured Jodelle Ferland and Daniela Bobadilla) instead of evaluating the claim using the provided Hop 1 passages, none of which mentioned the movie '400 Boys'.
findings.quote: Researching the cast of 400 Boys (2013), the film features actors including Jodelle Ferland, Daniela Bobadilla
